goal: 时间、总分总、因果三种段落混着来 —— 限时挑战

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话

blocks.text: Last Friday, our class went on a school trip.
We set off at six in the morning.
After two hours, we reached the mountain.
We climbed to the top and took many photos.
In the evening, we came back home, tired but happy.

distractors.text: Our teacher is very strict with us.

rounds.explain: 五句叙事：Last Friday 交代时间，然后 set off → reached → climbed → came back，一条时间线走到底。In the evening 和开头的 Last Friday 首尾呼应。老师严不严，跟这次出游没关系。
rounds.example: Last Friday → set off → reached → climbed → In the evening
rounds.win: 五句话也能排得严丝合缝。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 总分总：观点 + 两个理由 + 例子 + 结论

blocks.text: Learning a foreign language is good for you.
First, it opens the door to other cultures.
Moreover, it makes your brain work better.
For example, studies show it can improve memory.
In conclusion, everyone should learn at least one foreign language.

rounds.explain: 标准的总分总：观点 → First 理由一 → Moreover 理由二 → For example 例子 → In conclusion 结论。四个信号词把一个段落切得清清楚楚。cousin 会三门语言是个人例子，撑不起全段的结论。
rounds.example: 观点 → First → Moreover → For example → In conclusion
rounds.win: 信号词齐了，段落结构自己就浮出来了。

rounds.cn: 把这几句话排成一段通顺的话
rounds.tip: 这一段的因果有点绕：先说结果，再倒回去讲原因

blocks.text: The small shop closed last month.
The rent had gone up twice in one year.
As a result, the owner could not make any profit.
Finally, he decided to move to another street.

distractors.text: The shop used to sell fresh vegetables.

rounds.explain: 这一段先抛结果（店关了），再回头讲原因（房租涨了两次），然后顺着往下说（赚不到钱 → 搬走）。先果后因是写作里常见的写法，读起来更抓人。蔬菜那句是背景，会把因果链岔开。
rounds.example: 先说结果 → 倒回原因 → As a result → Finally
rounds.win: 因果不一定是先因后果，也可以先抛结果。
